assertions.evidence_summary: IL2 promoted cell-cycle entry in lymphocyte cultures preconditioned with a submitogenic PHA dose.
assertions.uncertainty: Figure3 four independent donor experiments;mean±SEM;harmonized numerical effect withheld.
assertions.causal_directness: Sequential mitogen/cytokine perturbation;not IL2alone.
assertions.limitations: PHA is a polyclonal mitogen,not antigen-specific TCR stimulation. Table1 has inconsistent timing/dose labels; record uses Figure3-specific context and remains low-confidence pending independent review.

scoring_annotation.tested_hypothesis: IL2 promotes S+G2+M-phase entry in human lymphocytes after weakPHA preconditioning.
scoring_annotation.rationale: The recorded contrast supports this narrow hypothesis in the assayed context only. Pending independent review; needs_full_text records remain ineligible for default prior scoring.

No complete paths constructed. No human receptor knockout inferred from mouse arms. Ligand neutralization and signaling inhibitors are not direct binding evidence. Antisense and pharmacological specificity remain limited.

All six assigned cytokines have primary human responses represented. Coverage is a targeted supplement rather than a systematic or exhaustive review. Broad source-secretion and receptor-perturbation gaps remain; no counts were inflated by transporting unmeasured biology.

synthesis: This targeted expansion covers CSF2-induced eosinophil proteins and ICAM1-dependent survival;IL5 survival and a mutant adhesion contrast;IL2 STAT5 activation and quiescent/competent-cell contexts;IL17A-induced fibroblast IL6 with dose/inhibitor contrasts;IL1A-associated keratinocyte and fibroblast responses;and partial IL16-dependent adult CD4 chemotaxis induced by amniotic fluid. Relevant full methods are inspected for all sources. Null observations remain inconclusive for absence. No complete path or calibrated numerical prior is constructed.
